description: Flat metadata schema for individual confocal laser scanning microscopy records of primary neuronal cultures with synaptic structure analysis under pharmacological treatment.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual image/record (e.g., sample-image ID).

experiment_date.descr: Date of imaging or sample acquisition (YYYY-MM-DD).

species.descr: Biological species of the donor organism (e.g., rat, mouse).

strain.descr: Rodent strain or line used for primary neuron isolation (e.g., Sprague-Dawley, C57BL/6).

sex.descr: Sex of the donor animal, if known (e.g., male, female, mixed, unknown).

age_or_developmental_stage.descr: Age or developmental stage at tissue collection (e.g., P0, P7, embryonic day 18, postnatal day 1).

brain_region.descr: Source brain region of primary neurons (e.g., hippocampus, cortex, striatum).

cell_type.descr: Primary neuronal subtype or culture type (e.g., cortical neuron, hippocampal neuron, mixed neuronal culture).

culture_system.descr: Culture format used for the sample (e.g., dissociated primary culture, organotypic slice culture).

culture_days_in_vitro.descr: Number of days in vitro at the time of imaging (DIV).

plating_density_cells_per_cm2.descr: Initial plating density of neurons, in cells per cm^2.

coating_substrate.descr: Substrate/coating used for cell attachment (e.g., poly-D-lysine, laminin).

fixation_used.descr: Whether the sample was fixed prior to imaging.

fixative.descr: Fixative used, if applicable (e.g., 4% paraformaldehyde, glutaraldehyde).

permeabilization_agent.descr: Permeabilization reagent and approximate concentration, if applicable (e.g., Triton X-100 0.1%).

blocking_solution.descr: Blocking solution composition used before staining (e.g., 5% BSA in PBS).

staining_target.descr: Primary staining target(s), such as postsynaptic density markers or synaptic proteins (e.g., PSD-95, Homer1).

stain_type.descr: Type of label used for the main target (e.g., immunofluorescence, genetically encoded fluorophore, dye).

secondary_antibody_host.descr: Host species of the secondary antibody, if applicable (e.g., goat, donkey).

fluorophore.descr: Fluorophore name(s) used for the principal channel(s) (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488, Cy3).

pharmacological_treatment_name.descr: Name of the neurotransmitter receptor antagonist or other pharmacological agent applied (e.g., CNQX, APV, bicuculline).

pharmacological_target.descr: Primary receptor/pathway targeted by the treatment (e.g., AMPA receptor, NMDA receptor, GABA_A receptor).

treatment_duration_min.descr: Duration of treatment exposure in minutes.

treatment_timing_relative_to_imaging.descr: Timing of treatment relative to imaging (e.g., pre-treatment, during imaging, post-fixation).

vehicle_control.descr: Vehicle used for the treatment, if any (e.g., DMSO, saline), or none.

sample_temperature_c.descr: Temperature of the sample during imaging in degrees Celsius (°C).

mounting_medium.descr: Mounting medium used for imaging/final preparation (e.g., ProLong Gold).

objective_numerical_aperture.descr: Numerical aperture of the objective lens.

objective_immersion.descr: Immersion medium of the objective (e.g., oil, water, glycerol, air).

microscope_model.descr: Microscope model used for image acquisition.

confocal_type.descr: Confocal platform type (e.g., laser scanning confocal, spinning disk).

laser_wavelengths_nm.descr: Laser excitation wavelength(s) in nanometers (nm); if multiple, record as a comma-separated string or standardized list string.

laser_power_percent.descr: Laser power at the sample or source setting expressed as percent, if available.

detector_type.descr: Detector type used (e.g., PMT, GaAsP, HyD).

emission_bandpass_nm.descr: Emission detection window(s) in nanometers (nm), e.g., 500-550.

pinhole_diameter_airy_units.descr: Confocal pinhole size in Airy units.

scan_mode.descr: Image acquisition scan mode (e.g., bidirectional, sequential, resonant).

scan_speed.descr: Scan speed or dwell-related acquisition setting, as reported by the microscope software.

z_stack_slices.descr: Number of optical sections in the z-stack.

voxel_size_x_um.descr: Voxel size in the x dimension in micrometers (µm) per pixel.

voxel_size_y_um.descr: Voxel size in the y dimension in micrometers (µm) per pixel.

voxel_size_z_um.descr: Voxel size in the z dimension in micrometers (µm).

acquisition_software.descr: Name of the acquisition software used (e.g., Zeiss ZEN, Leica LAS X, Nikon NIS-Elements).

tiling_used.descr: Whether tiling/multiple fields were acquired and stitched.

z_projection_used.descr: Whether a z-projection was generated for analysis or presentation.

deconvolution_used.descr: Whether deconvolution was applied to the image data.

psd_marker_channel.descr: Channel used to identify the postsynaptic density marker (e.g., PSD-95 channel index or label).

synapse_region_of_interest.descr: Anatomical or cellular region analyzed within the synapse (e.g., postsynaptic density, spine head, dendritic shaft).

morphology_metric_name.descr: Name of the synaptic morphology metric measured (e.g., PSD area, synapse volume, spine head diameter).

morphology_metric_value.descr: Measured value of the morphology metric.

morphology_metric_unit.descr: Unit for the morphology metric value (e.g., µm2, µm3, µm).

analysis_software.descr: Software used for downstream image analysis and quantification (e.g., Fiji, Imaris, CellProfiler).

segmentation_method.descr: Method used to segment synaptic structures (e.g., thresholding, machine learning, manual tracing).

quality_control_passed.descr: Whether the record passed quality control for analysis inclusion.

qc_notes.descr: Brief notes on artifacts or QC issues, if any (e.g., photobleaching, saturation, motion).

replicate_id.descr: Biological or technical replicate identifier for the sample/record.

operator.descr: Person who performed the imaging or acquisition.
